entities.summary: Dutch East India Company, a political institution in Netherlands during The Dutch Golden Age (1602–1700). Grew from Dutch East India Company (VOC) founded – first publicly traded company and Golden Age Art & Science. Led to the emergence of Amsterdam Exchange Bank and Tulip Mania & the Commercial Republic.
